Name: Miner of Duty
Overview:
Miner of Duty is a block-building FPS. The game includes 5 multiplayer game modes: Team Deathmatch, FFA, Fort Wars, Search & Mine, and Custom Maps. Also, Swarm Mode, a zombie-survival game mode, is playable as an offline game mode.

Custom Map mode allows you to design a map and play it with others.

You are able to customize your character's looks and your weapon classes with an array of weapons.
